baseline_candidate_ranking: global popularity over the same test window (MRR = 1/pop_rank)

metrics.event_cov: share of August outgoing events covered by selected wallets
metrics.hard_event_cov: share of events whose true counterparty is outside the global top-100 popular
metrics.headroom_cov: share of (1 - pop_mrr) * events, i.e. room for an agent to beat popularity
metrics.p2_scored: selected wallets with a valid June lag-1 trigger score

interpretation: P3 (difficulty x future-new-counterparty consequence) dominates raw volume at every budget on event/hard-event/headroom coverage.
At 1% budget P3 covers 22.7% of hard events vs 14.6% raw volume and 1.3% random (~17x random).
P2 hourly lag-1 trigger is informative only at >=20% budget with a June-only window; denser daily/weekly aggregation and longer windows are expected improvements (v2).
Headroom coverage <= event coverage for volume but >= for P3: P3 concentrates budget where the popularity baseline is weak.
These are SELECTION-layer results only; end-task Recall@K/MRR with the budgeted agents is the next experiment.
boundaries: importance_proxy_p3 uses fwd30 labels of the SAME snapshot month for ranking demonstration; the production router must be trained on May/June snapshots and frozen for August.
P2 trigger window is 2022-06 only; hourly grid is sparse for low-volume wallets (2,038 of 14,189 outgoing wallets score).
No X features used; P6 social fusion pending the GCP extraction of the 34.8 GiB file.
